join hortbot 999 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add everest It's anyone's (_PARAMETER_OR_Everest_).
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!everest
send hortbot #foobar [HB] It's anyone's Everest.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!everest game
send hortbot #foobar [HB] It's anyone's game.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add everest It's anyone's (_PARAMETER_1_OR_Everest_). Right, (_P_2_OR_dude_)?
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!everest
send hortbot #foobar [HB] It's anyone's Everest. Right, dude?

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!everest game
send hortbot #foobar [HB] It's anyone's game. Right, dude?

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!everest game ; friend
send hortbot #foobar [HB] It's anyone's game. Right, friend?


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add everest It's anyone's "(_P_OR__)".
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!everest
send hortbot #foobar [HB] It's anyone's "".

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!everest foobar
send hortbot #foobar [HB] It's anyone's "foobar".
